parsed.internal_thinking: Gemini just rolled an 8 and got brick + wheat from node 23, plus wood + ore from node 41. She now has 3 wheat + 1 ore in hand. She's passing the turn to me. Let me check the board state: robber is at hex 10 (desert), so node 23 is NOT blocked - I was wrong in my notes. She got resources from both settlements. This is good production for her. She has 2 VP, I have 2 VP, ג'ימי has 2 VP. I'm about to roll. My current hand: 2 wheat, 2 sheep, 1 ore. I need brick and ore to build my next settlement at node 14 (10 pips: Wh8, W3, W4). If I roll well, I can get brick from node 25 (B10 touches hex 6 which is B6 - wait, let me recheck. Node 25 touches hexes 11, 12, 7. H[11]=O3, H[12]=S4, H[7]=Wh3. So node 25 produces ore, sheep, wheat - not brick. I was confused. Let me recalculate my node 20: touches hexes 1, 5, 4. H[1]=W12, H[5]=B6, H[4]=S8. So wood, brick, sheep. Good. Node 25 is ore, sheep, wheat. So I don't have direct brick access except through node 20. Gemini is building resource engines and has 3 wheat now - she might be planning to build a road or settlement soon. I should focus on getting brick + ore to build my third settlement. No immediate threat, but she's ahead on resources. I'll roll next.
